purpose: Sound-design contrast targets agreed after listening to the first ten-style batch. Test articulation, continuous bass, instrument exclusions, lead hooks and phrase variation separately. Human quality ratings are unfilled.

cases.label: 80s synth-pop — lead hook and arpeggios
cases.prompt: 80s synth pop instrumental in D major at 112bpm, 32 bars, with a memorable lead melody, warm sustained pads, bright arpeggios, octave bass and gated snares, no piano

cases.label: Dark metallic bass — held throughout
cases.prompt: dark heavy metallic bass in F minor at 100bpm, 32 bars, with deep crunchy extended bass throughout the song, slow filter movement, a clean sub underneath, sparse drums, dark pads and no piano

cases.label: Halftime dubstep — growls and bass phrases
cases.prompt: 140bpm halftime dubstep in F minor, 32 bars, with deep dark synth pads, growling wobble bass and alternating bass phrases, a clean deep sub, sparse melodic parts and no piano
